en: Ah, it's you! You know, I simply love Pokémon. I built this tower so that I could share that love with everyone.
I do hope people enjoy our shows.
Ahem. Is this thing on? This is your Director speaking. From today we'll be broadcasting shows in praise of Team Rocket!
And I don't want to hear any complaints. Just do your jobs and...
Yikes! Can't you see I'm busy pretending to be the... Hang on. Who are you?
It's me, Petrel! I was playing the Director so the whole region would come round to Team Rocket's side.
This time I'm not holding anything back. Give me everything you've got!
All right, all right, listen. We locked the real Director in the warehouse under the city, at the far end of the Goldenrod Tunnel.
And since I'm such a nice guy, you can have the Basement Key. Take it, and say thank you!
Ha! Off you go, then. And don't come back!
The Director's in the warehouse at the far end of the Goldenrod Tunnel. Ha! I doubt a kid like you will get that far.
